chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb narrated from Mismaʿ ibn ʿAbd al-Malik, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who performs an independent ʿUmrah, then performs the obligatory tawaf of the House, then has relations with his wife before performing saʿy between al-Safa and al-Marwah.

He عليه السلام said: “He has invalidated his ʿUmrah, and a camel is due from him. He shall remain in Makkah until the month in which he performed the ʿUmrah has passed, then he shall go out to the appointed miqat that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم designated for his people, enter into ihram from it, and perform ʿUmrah.”

key_terms.الصَّفَا وَ الْمَرْوَةِ: the two sacred points between which saʿy is performed
key_terms.بَدَنَةٌ: a camel offered as an expiatory sacrifice
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ: the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family
key_terms.طَوَافَ الْفَرِيضَةِ: the obligatory circumambulation of the Kaʿbah
key_terms.عُمْرَةً مُفْرَدَةً: an independent ʿUmrah performed separately from hajj tamattuʿ
key_terms.فَيُحْرِمُ: he enters into ihram from the prescribed place
key_terms.يَغْشَى امْرَأَتَهُ: has marital relations with his wife

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone has marital relations before completing saʿy in ʿUmrah Mufradah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who has marital relations during an independent ʿUmrah after tawaf but before saʿy. It states that the ʿUmrah is invalidated, a badanah is required, and the person must wait, return to the proper miqat, re-enter ihram, and perform a new ʿUmrah.
